meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按需载入固定的工作模式指令,避免重复输入
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给代理设定一种持续生效的工作模式又不愿每次重述指令。
copy.tagline_en: Load a predefined work-mode directive on demand without repeating it.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to keep a work-mode directive active without restating it each time.

howto.what: 你要求进入“ultrawork 模式”后，Claude 会先宣告开启，然后按严格流程执行编码任务：先明确目标和验收标准，用记事本和清单跟进；实现前先写会失败的测试，改进到通过为止，并在最后用真实运行结果或截图证明完成，而不只是说一句“好了”。
howto.when: 当你开口要求“进入 ultrawork 模式”（直接说 ultrawork mode 也行），并且这次对话还没载入过这份指令时，它就会触发接管。

say.text: 进入 ultrawork 模式，处理这个任务。
say.note: Claude 会先输出固定宣告行，再按流程干活。

say.text: 开启 ultrawork 模式，修复登录报错的问题。
say.note: 会先写失败的测试，再改到通过并用运行结果证明。

say.text: 用 ultrawork 模式做这个新功能并验证结果。
say.note: 会记录目标与步骤，收尾给出真实运行或截图证据。

howto.what_en: On request, Claude announces ultrawork mode and runs a strict coding workflow: define goals/success criteria, track notes/todos, write failing checks first, then implement until green, and prove with real evidence.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to enter ultrawork mode and this directive is not already loaded in the conversation.

say_en.text: Enter ultrawork mode and handle this task.
say_en.note: Claude announces the mode first, then follows the workflow.

say_en.text: Start ultrawork mode and fix the login error.
say_en.note: Writes a failing test first, then proves the fix works.

say_en.text: Use ultrawork mode for this new feature and verify it.
say_en.note: Closes with test results or run/screenshot proof.
